release.name: VectorForge v1.0.0 — Deterministic Developer Shape Studio
release.body:
### ⚡ VectorForge v1.0.0 Release Notes

We are thrilled to ship the initial production release of **VectorForge**: the deterministic, zero-runtime-dependency developer SVG shape and component library.

#### 🌟 Highlights
- **235 Professional Developer Shapes**: Across 7 categories (Banners, Terminals, Skylines, Architectures, Badges, Repo Cards, Holograms).
- **Zero External Runtime Dependencies**: 100% self-contained W3C SVG 1.1 assets, compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
- **10 Curated Color Themes**: High-contrast palettes including Kemet Nocturne, Cyberpunk 2077, Nord Frost, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Monokai Pro, Emerald Matrix, Amber CRT, Solarized Dark, and Rosé Pine.
- **Node.js & NPX Support**: Run directly via `npx vectorforge <cmd>` with zero install overhead.
- **Python Package (PEP 621)**: `pip install vectorforge` with `vectorforge` CLI command.
- **Model Context Protocol (FastMCP)**: Native stdio JSON-RPC MCP server (`vectorforge.mcp_server`) for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and AI agents.
- **Reusable GitHub Action**: Pin with `uses: MikeeeDeV/MikeeeDeV@v1` in any repository workflow.
- **Interactive Showroom Gallery**: Live on GitHub Pages at https://mikeeedev.github.io/MikeeeDeV/ with real-time React JSX export and 1-click jsDelivr CDN embeds.

issue.title: security(ledger): enforce 24-hour rate limiting, strict sanitization, and bot-processed labeling
issue.body:
### Security & Anti-Spam Hardening
Visitor Ledger processes automated issues into profile SVG commits. To protect against malicious payloads and spam floods:
1. **24-Hour Rate Limiting**: Limit each GitHub username to 1 handshake per 24-hour window based on recorded ISO timestamps.
2. **Strict HTML/Markdown Sanitization**: Strip dangerous HTML tags, markdown links, code blocks, control characters, and enforce length boundaries.
3. **Automated `bot-processed` Label**: Automatically tag processed issues with `bot-processed` label before closure.
4. **Unit Tests**: Add tests verifying rate limiting and sanitization behavior.

issue.title: feat(npm): add Node.js package.json and zero-dependency npx CLI executable
issue.body:
### JavaScript Ecosystem Enablement
To make VectorForge seamlessly accessible to React, Next.js, and Node.js developers without requiring a Python runtime:
1. **`package.json`**: Standard npm package metadata with `bin.vectorforge` pointing to `./bin/vectorforge.js`.
2. **Pure Node.js CLI (`bin/vectorforge.js`)**: Zero-dependency executable utilizing Node standard library (`fs`, `path`).
3. **Full Parity with Python CLI**: Supports `npx vectorforge list`, `search`, `generate`, `init`, `build`, and `embed`.

issue.title: feat(cli): add dynamic parameter injection and vectorforge.json build engine
issue.body:
### Developer Tooling Enhancement
To enable developers to configure, automate, and batch-render custom profile assets:
1. **Dynamic Parameter Placeholders (`--param key=value`)**: Support overriding titles, subtitles, technical stacks, roles, and metric counters in any shape.
2. **Config File Integration (`vectorforge.json`)**: Declarative configuration defining target outputs, presets, themes, and parameters.
3. **`vectorforge init` Command**: Scaffolds a turnkey starter `vectorforge.json` with schema validation.
4. **`vectorforge build` Command**: Batch-renders all configured assets with determinism and visual console progress.
